title: Filing: Alibaba says its chip design unit T-Head filed on September 11 for a Hong Kong listing after exchange clearance; T-Head is set to remain a subsidiary (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Filing: Alibaba says its chip design unit T-Head filed on September 11 for a Hong Kong listing after exchange clearance; T-Head is set to remain a subsidiary — Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.'s chip design unit T-Head has filed for a Hong Kong listing, moving ahead with a proposed spinoff …
